name: Oddly
description: An educational Microsoft sample with a custom chat canvas for Copilot Studio. Brainstorm with your agent, save ideas to native per-user memory, and recall them across chats. Includes Oddly's agent instructions.

screenshot.alt: Oddly's welcome screen with its lavender mascot, idea starters, and a mock sidebar showing recent chats and three memories.

prerequisites: Sample mode works without an agent and uses clearly labeled, scripted local responses.
Live chat requires a published Copilot Studio agent and a user with access to it.

Bind the native Agents / Agent Node connector (shared_agentnode) in action mode, with InvokeAgent permitted by tenant policy. Use the authenticated Local Play or hosted player and complete platform connection consent.
Provide your own environment ID and agent schema name in the in-app agent dialog. No custom Entra registration, redirect URI, access token, or client secret is needed.
To save and recall ideas, enable native Memory in Copilot Studio and publish the agent.

One agent selection is remembered locally. Connecting or returning to it automatically requests its memories and may consume credits. Chats and sample bookmarks remain page-local; native memories are not cached in browser storage and expire after 28 days of inactivity with the agent.
Live answers arrive as complete text turns. Streaming, tool activity, interactive cards, uploads, and suggested actions are not supported.

connectors.instructions: Select your own Agents / Agent Node connection in the native CLI. The app expects generated/dataSources.ts with the agentnode InvokeAgent operation. Its companion transport retrieves asynchronous completion through the native host without changing generated bindings. Open the authenticated player, complete connection consent, then enter your published agent's environment ID and schema name. Follow-up turns reuse the returned conversationId through the x-ms-conversation-id parameter.
